title: Import tooling: IHAVE bulk ingestion, suck pull, mbox backfill
description: Implement tools for importing articles from legacy Usenet infrastructure into IPFS: (1) IHAVE-based bulk push from another NNTP server, (2) pull-style suck from a remote NNTP server, (3) mbox file backfill for offline archives. All import paths validate, sign, store to IPFS, and append to the group log identically to the live ingestion path.
